response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and tooling experience with a focus on web, mobile, and desktop systems, but lacks direct experience in embedded firmware development for LAN-switch security features. His C/C++ background is limited to a short stint at National Instruments, and there is no evidence of Japanese language proficiency or deep networking/security expertise in the resume.
strengths: Extensive experience in software development (10+ years) with a focus on testability and modern practices (TDD, CI/CD).
Diverse technical background including low-latency systems, microservices, and open-source contributions.
Strong problem-solving skills demonstrated through workshops, talks, and tooling projects (e.g., Fluent-Asserts, Trial).
concerns: No explicit experience with embedded firmware or LAN-switch products, which are core to the role.
Japanese language proficiency not mentioned (required for the role).
Limited recent experience with C (critical for UNIX/Linux kernel work) and security/networking technologies.
